pages.text: $(li)$(l)Ferrous Wroughtnaut$(): asleep in an iron chamber underground. Only its back can be hurt. It guards the $(l:bosses/mowzie#wrought_axe)Axe of a Thousand Metals$(/l).

$(li)$(l)Frostmaw$(): sleeping in the snow, holding an $(l:bosses/mowzie#ice_crystal)Ice Crystal$(/l). Taking the crystal is a mistake you'll only make once.$(li)$(l)Umvuthi$(): the Sunbird, on a throne in the savanna.
